scope: First independently reloadable output before fitting, evidence-based task reading, and an optional experiment proposal informed by observed training feedback. No task-name routing.
delivery_acceptance: Interrupt controlled, otherwise normal solves after the first prediction is published. Reload the frozen snapshot in a fresh process and verify rows, class domain, probability columns when required, and prediction digest. A complete run must replace the partial output. Invalid inputs must not gain a success receipt.
reader_acceptance: Use anonymous worked metric examples with task-declared alternatives and precision. Check unique, ambiguous, rounded, incompatible, and missing evidence via the ordinary loader and solve. Never use development or official evaluation labels to infer the contract.
feedback_acceptance: Give the optional reviewer the task and a measured training result, require a falsifiable hypothesis, and check it using later training-only evidence. Keep an inconclusive idea explicitly deferred. Inspect a fresh task under the same mode. Preserve the deliverable throughout.
evaluation: Freeze predictions before opening any designated validation labels. Compare the shipped default on the two original course packages, independently reload, and distinguish partial delivery, default performance, and optional research outcomes. Preserve joint blind tasks and official course tests.
